learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=50, l2_regularization=1.0), unweighted fit
threshold: survey-weighted Youden J on calibration PSUs (t* = 0.205-0.215 across folds)
multicalibration: logit patches on group x probability-bin cells; patch if |gap| > max(0.01, 2 SE_eff); cells >= 200 children; eta 0.5
bootstrap: stratified PSU bootstrap (PSUs resampled within 970 strata); B = 1000 for M0, 500 otherwise
3T_list: Perpres 63/2020 (62 regencies; 61 present in SKI 2023, Intan Jaya not sampled)
